"""Read-only production regression comparison; all consumer state is temporary."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tests'))
import test_ledger_post as fixture
import test_hooks_shell as legacy

script = ROOT / 'hooks/progress-line.sh'
base = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', 'a157679afd27743b1dd1e1a7fa76444cca6aba2a:hooks/progress-line.sh'],
                      cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
assert script.read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n') == base
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='f2-lens-b-') as temporary:
    root, first = fixture.project(Path(temporary))
    second = root / 'docs/roadmap/other/tasks.md'
    second.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    second.write_text(fixture.TEXT.replace('Second', 'Different second'), encoding='utf-8')
    hook = fixture.service()
    first_output = hook.process_payload(fixture.payload(first), root)
    assert '\U0001f4cb demo' in first_output
    edits = {'tool_name': 'MultiEdit', 'tool_input': {'edits': [
        {'file_path': str(first)}, {'file_path': str(second)}]}}
    native_output = hook.process_payload(edits, root)
    assert '\U0001f4cb' not in native_output
    previous = subprocess.run([legacy.BASH, str(script)], input=json.dumps(edits),
        cwd=root, env={**os.environ, 'CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR': str(root), 'CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT': str(ROOT)},
        capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', check=True)
    assert not previous.stderr
    old_output = json.loads(previous.stdout)['systemMessage']
    assert '\U0001f4cb other' in old_output
    result = {'production_head': '71968b0f4c2281081de4fc5a8aba9310e2bd2001',
        'legacy_wrapper_matches_base': True, 'base_wrapper_sha256_lf': hashlib.sha256(base).hexdigest(),
        'scenario': 'Emit demo once, then MultiEdit [demo, other] where other has different progress',
        'first_output': first_output, 'native_multi_output': native_output, 'base_progress_output': old_output,
        'regression_reproduced': True}
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))

"""Compare top-level MultiEdit file_path with base wrappers; temp consumers only."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tests'))
import test_ledger_post as fixture
import test_hooks_shell as legacy

for name in ('ledger-lint-warn.sh', 'mark-docs-pending.sh'):
    base = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', 'a157679afd27743b1dd1e1a7fa76444cca6aba2a:hooks/' + name],
        cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
    assert (ROOT / 'hooks' / name).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n') == base
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='f2-lens-b-top-level-') as temporary:
    root, ledger = fixture.project(Path(temporary))
    value = {'tool_name': 'MultiEdit', 'tool_input': {'file_path': str(ledger),
        'edits': [{'old_string': 'old', 'new_string': 'new'}]}}
    env = legacy.env_de(root, Path(temporary))
    native_lint = fixture.service().process_payload(value, root)
    old_lint = legacy.hook('ledger-lint-warn.sh', value, env)
    assert native_lint == '' and 'ledger-lint:' in old_lint[1]
    marker = root / '.claude/.confluence-pending'
    native = subprocess.run([shutil.which('node'), str(ROOT / 'hooks/run-hook.mjs'),
        'mark-docs-pending.sh', '--runtime=claude'], input=json.dumps(value), env=env,
        cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', check=True)
    native_created = marker.exists()
    old_marker = legacy.hook('mark-docs-pending.sh', value, env)
    assert not native_created and marker.exists()
    result = {'production_head': '71968b0f4c2281081de4fc5a8aba9310e2bd2001',
        'legacy_wrappers_match_base': True,
        'scenario': 'MultiEdit top-level file_path and edits[] old_string/new_string with no nested file_path',
        'native_lint_output': native_lint, 'base_lint_output': old_lint[1],
        'native_marker_created': native_created, 'native_marker_diagnostic': native.stderr,
        'base_marker_created': marker.exists(), 'base_marker_exit': old_marker[0],
        'regression_reproduced': True}
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))

import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import types

REL = 'skills/adversarial-review/scripts/review-lens-select.py'
REVISIONS = {'before': 'a157679afd27743b1dd1e1a7fa76444cca6aba2a',
             'after': '71968b0f4c2281081de4fc5a8aba9310e2bd2001'}
modules, hashes = {}, {}
for label, revision in REVISIONS.items():
    source = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{revision}:{REL}'])
    module = types.ModuleType('perf_' + label)
    module.__file__ = str(pathlib.Path(REL).resolve())
    exec(compile(source.decode('utf-8'), module.__file__, 'exec'), module.__dict__)
    modules[label] = module
    hashes[label] = hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()

report = {'revisions': REVISIONS, 'source_sha256': hashes,
          'python': platform.python_version(), 'platform': platform.platform(),
          'method': 'Same temporary ASCII one-line source; alternate before/after order; two samples each. Invoke the full-file reader used by --files and untracked paths. Assert exact output equality.',
          'limitations': ['Local wall times include host interference; no native client or OneDrive latency claim.',
                         'Measures reader only; no full-selector end-to-end timing claim.',
                         'Accumulated split scan is a deterministic work count, independent of timing.'],
          'results': []}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='review-lens-d-receipt-') as folder:
    path = pathlib.Path(folder) / 'sdk.min.js'
    for mib in [1, 2, 4]:
        size = mib * 1024 * 1024
        path.write_bytes(b'x' * size + b'\n')
        samples = {'before': [], 'after': []}
        for iteration in range(2):
            order = ['before', 'after'] if iteration == 0 else ['after', 'before']
            for label in order:
                start = time.perf_counter()
                lines = modules[label].lineas_fichero_entero(str(path))
                samples[label].append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
                assert len(lines) == 1 and lines[0] == (1, 'x' * size)
        blocks = size // 8192
        row = {'mib': mib, 'samples_ms': samples,
               'median_ms': {label: statistics.median(values) for label, values in samples.items()},
               'repeated_split_scan_lower_bound_bytes': 8192 * blocks * (blocks + 1) // 2,
               'baseline_input_bytes': size + 1, 'equal_output': True}
        report['results'].append(row)
        print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
pathlib.Path('.pytest_cache/f2-lens-d-attempt1.json').write_text(
    json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
